source_name: Office of the Prime Minister opm.gov.jm speeches (Wayback/CDX)
leaders_covered: Andrew Holness; Portia Simpson Miller; Bruce Golding
notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-27 (--spread --n 8): 415 captures kept - 396 under /speech(es)/<slug> (2013-2026) plus the root-level speech-/address-/statement-/remarks- posts. GREENFIELD (no live Jamaica recipe). TITLE/TEXT/DATE all green on every sample; bodies are REAL PM speeches of 8.0k-20.5k chars (Simpson Miller's 2012 address to the 7th Regional Investments and Capital Markets Conference; Holness's 2022 opening of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs HQ), dates 2012-2024. WHICH OFFICE: the PRIME MINISTER is Jamaica's head of GOVERNMENT and the substantive speaker - the Governor-General (kingshouse.gov.jm) is the ceremonial Crown representative and is deliberately NOT targeted. Harvested from the BARE HOST because the three speech shapes (/speech/<slug>, /speeches/<slug>, and root-level /address-by-...) share no common prefix; the link_pattern is anchored at $ so the ?utm_/?share tracking duplicates are dropped. TITLE comes from <title> with a suffix-stripping LOOKAHEAD regex - h1.entry-title matches TWICE on the current generation (a 'Speech by the Prime Minister' category label plus the headline) and first_match joins all matches; the lookahead form is required because the engine's title regex keeps group(0), not group(1). The general /news/<slug> stream (1,746 captures of third-person press reporting) is deliberately EXCLUDED and could be a separate recipe if official_statement coverage is wanted. NO speaker_default (Holness, Simpson Miller, Golding) -> tenure crosscheck. FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
